title: A true story 一个真实的故事
description: A true story about the author's friend George: while George was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen, entered the dining room and turned on a torch. Suddenly a voice called out and the thieves dropped the torch and ran away. George came downstairs, turned on the light and found the thieves had already gone, but his parrot Henry was still there calling out. The lesson introduces the past perfect with 'already' and the words story, happen, thief, enter, dark, torch, voice and parrot.
answer_note: The listening comprehension question and workbook A (Comprehension) are model answers (suggested). Workbook B (Structure) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-118-123.jpg). Grammar I (past perfect 'already'), II (Jimmy's diary: After/Before) and III (combine with 'when') are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.554-555). Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. Who called out to the thieves in the dark? 听录音，然后回答问题。谁在暗处对窃贼喊了一声？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。谁在暗处对窃贼喊了一声？

lesson.text: Do you like stories? I want to tell you a true story. It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
lesson.translation: 你喜欢听故事吗？ 我要告诉你一个真实的故事。 这是一年前发生在我的一个朋友身上的故事。

lesson.text: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
lesson.translation: 当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时， 两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

lesson.text: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room. It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
lesson.translation: 他们进到屋里后， 走进了饭厅。 饭厅里很暗， 于是他们打开了手电筒。

lesson.text: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them. 'What's up? What's up?' someone called. The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
lesson.translation: 突然他们听到身后有声音。 “什么事？什么事？”有人叫着。 小偷扔下了手电筒， 飞快地逃走了。

lesson.text: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
lesson.translation: 乔治听到了响声， 迅速地下楼。

lesson.text: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone. The thieves had already gone.
lesson.translation: 他打开灯， 但不见一个人。 小偷逃走了。

lesson.text: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there. 'What's up, George?' he called. 'Nothing, Henry,' George said and smiled. 'Go back to sleep.'
lesson.translation: 但是乔治的鹦鹉亨利仍在那里。 “什么事，乔治？”它叫着。 “没事，亨利。”乔治笑着说， “接着睡觉吧。”

lesson.title: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about who called out to the thieves.

questions.prompt: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?
questions.answer: George's parrot, Henry, called out to the thieves.

items.title: 1. as quickly as they could
items.text: as quickly as they could 是状语，修饰 ran away。第 1 个 as 是副词，第 2 个 as 是连词，引导比较状语从句。could 后省略了 run，是“能跑多快就跑多快”的意思。

items.title: 3. he called
items.text: he 指 parrot。英语中，动物有时用 he 或 she 代替，是“拟人”的写法。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 241 and answer these questions. 看第 241 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 看第 241 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: Model comprehension answers drawn from the text.

questions.prompt: Did this true story happen to the author or to a friend of the author's? And when?
questions.answer: It happened to a friend of the author's, a year ago.

questions.prompt: What was the author's friend's name?
questions.answer: His name was George.

questions.prompt: What was George doing?
questions.answer: He was reading in bed.

questions.prompt: What happened while he was reading in bed?
questions.answer: Two thieves climbed into his kitchen.

questions.prompt: When did they go into the dining room?
questions.answer: After they had entered the house.

questions.prompt: Why did they turn on a torch?
questions.answer: Because it was very dark.

questions.prompt: What did they hear behind them?
questions.answer: They heard a voice behind them.

questions.prompt: What did someone call?
questions.answer: 'What's up? What's up?' someone called.

questions.prompt: What did the thieves do? And how quickly did they run away?
questions.answer: They dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.

questions.prompt: Did George hear the noise?
questions.answer: Yes, he did.

questions.prompt: What did he do?
questions.answer: He came downstairs quickly.

questions.prompt: Could he see anyone when he turned on the light?
questions.answer: No, he couldn't.

questions.prompt: What had the thieves already done?
questions.answer: They had already gone.

questions.prompt: Who was still there? And who had the thieves heard?
questions.answer: George's parrot, Henry, was still there, and the thieves had heard the parrot.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Answer the questions according to the example (past perfect with 'already')
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.554 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 answer-the-question items using the past perfect with 'already'; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you clean the car?
questions.answer: Because I had already cleaned it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you post the letter?
questions.answer: Because I had already posted it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you give the book back to him?
questions.answer: Because I had already given it back to him.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you sweep the floor?
questions.answer: Because I had already swept it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you finish your homework?
questions.answer: Because I had already finished it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you eat the steak?
questions.answer: Because I had already eaten it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you wash the dishes?
questions.answer: Because I had already washed them.

questions.prompt: Why didn't you telephone your mother?
questions.answer: Because I had already telephoned her.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the sentences according to Jimmy's diary (After / Before)
grammar.instruction: 根据吉米的日记完成下列句子。
grammar.translation: 根据吉米的日记完成下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.554-555 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context:
Jimmy's diary
7:00 — Got up.
7:10 — Washed and dressed.
7:30 — Had breakfast.
7:45 — Left home and went to school.
7:50 — Arrived at school. Walked into classroom.
7:55 — The teacher came into classroom.
8:00 — English lesson began.
8:45 — English lesson ended.
8:55 — Maths lesson began.
9:40 — Maths lesson ended.
9:45 — Ate bread and drank coffee.
10:00 — Science lesson began.
10:45 — Science lesson ended.
10:55 — Chinese lesson began.
11:40 — Chinese lesson ended. End of morning session.

questions.prompt: 1.a After Jimmy had got up, he washed and dressed. (printed example)
questions.answer: he washed and dressed.

questions.prompt: 1.b After Jimmy had washed and dressed, ___
questions.answer: he had his breakfast.

questions.prompt: 1.c After Jimmy had had his breakfast, ___
questions.answer: he left home and went to school.

questions.prompt: 1.d After Jimmy had walked into the classroom, ___
questions.answer: the teacher came into the classroom.

questions.prompt: 1.e After the teacher had come into the classroom, ___
questions.answer: the English lesson began.

questions.prompt: 1.f After the English lesson had ended, ___
questions.answer: the Maths lesson began.

questions.prompt: 1.g After the Maths lesson had ended, ___
questions.answer: Jimmy ate bread and drank coffee.

questions.prompt: 1.h After Jimmy had eaten bread and drunk coffee, ___
questions.answer: the Science lesson began.

questions.prompt: 1.i After the Science lesson had ended, ___
questions.answer: the Chinese lesson began.

questions.prompt: 1.j After the Chinese lesson had ended, ___
questions.answer: the morning session ended.

questions.prompt: 2.a Before Jimmy washed and dressed, he had got up. (printed example)
questions.answer: he had got up.

questions.prompt: 2.b Before Jimmy had his breakfast, ___
questions.answer: he had washed and dressed.

questions.prompt: 2.c Before Jimmy left home, ___
questions.answer: he had had his breakfast.

questions.prompt: 2.d Before the teacher came into the classroom, ___
questions.answer: Jimmy had walked into the classroom.

questions.prompt: 2.e Before the English lesson began, ___
questions.answer: the teacher had come into the classroom.

questions.prompt: 2.f Before the Maths lesson began, ___
questions.answer: the English lesson had ended.

questions.prompt: 2.g Before Jimmy ate bread and drank coffee, ___
questions.answer: the Maths lesson had ended.

questions.prompt: 2.h Before the Science lesson began, ___
questions.answer: Jimmy had eaten bread and drunk coffee.

questions.prompt: 2.i Before the Chinese lesson began, ___
questions.answer: the Science lesson had ended.

questions.prompt: 2.j Before the morning session ended, ___
questions.answer: the Chinese lesson had ended.

audio_context.text: First, listen to Jimmy's diary. Use this sequence to complete the sentences.
At seven ten, he washed and dressed.
At seven thirty, he had breakfast.
At seven forty-five, he left home and went to school.
At seven fifty, he arrived at school and walked into the classroom.
At seven fifty-five, the teacher came into the classroom.
At eight, the English lesson began.
At eight forty-five, the English lesson ended.
At eight fifty-five, the math lesson began.
At nine forty, the math lesson ended.
At nine forty-five, Jimmy ate bread and drank coffee.
At ten, the science lesson began.
At ten forty-five, the science lesson ended.
At ten fifty-five, the Chinese lesson began.
At eleven forty, the Chinese lesson ended. The morning session was over.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Combine each pair of sentences according to the example (using 'when')
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句合并下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句合并下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.555 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine items using 'when' + past perfect; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I washed. I cleaned my teeth.
questions.answer: When I had washed, I cleaned my teeth.

questions.prompt: She corrected the students' papers. She went to bed.
questions.answer: When she had corrected the students' papers, she went to bed.

questions.prompt: I cleaned my teeth. I had breakfast.
questions.answer: When I had cleaned my teeth, I had breakfast.

questions.prompt: The bus stopped. Tom got on.
questions.answer: When the bus had stopped, Tom got on.

questions.prompt: They sold their house. They went to a new town.
questions.answer: When they had sold their house, they went to a new town.

questions.prompt: They took their exams. They had a big party.
questions.answer: When they had taken their exams, they had a big party.

questions.prompt: The rain stopped. They all went out.
questions.answer: When the rain had stopped, they all went out.

questions.prompt: She read the letter. She told us the news.
questions.answer: When she had read the letter, she told us the news.

questions.prompt: Mary bought a ticket. She waited for the train.
questions.answer: When Mary had bought a ticket, she waited for the train.

questions.prompt: She finished her work. She went out for dinner.
questions.answer: When she had finished her work, she went out for dinner.
